headline: Names a Lynn, Massachusetts post office building after Thomas P. Costin, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 51 Willow Street in Lynn, Massachusetts. The building will be officially called the "Thomas P. Costin, Jr. Post Office Building." It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the new name applies from that date.
